items.name: Polynomial.taylor_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.taylor r) f = f.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C r)

items.name: Polynomial.algEquivAevalXAddC_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] (t : R) (a : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.algEquivAevalXAddC t) a = (Polynomial.aeval (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C t)) a

items.name: Polynomial.algEquivAevalXAddC
items.type: {R : Type u_3} → [inst : CommRing R] → R → Polynomial R ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.taylor
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → R → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_taylor
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : Polynomial R) (r s : R),
  (Polynomial.taylor r) ((Polynomial.taylor s) f) = (Polynomial.taylor (r + s)) f

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_X_pow
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (n : ℕ),
  (Polynomial.taylor r) (Polynomial.X ^ n) = (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C r) ^ n

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_X
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R), (Polynomial.taylor r) Polynomial.X = Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C r

items.name: Polynomial.map_taylor
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] (p : Polynomial R) (r : R) (f : R →+* S),
  Polynomial.map f ((Polynomial.taylor r) p) = (Polynomial.taylor (f r)) (Polynomial.map f p)
